name: Russia
exam_name: Экзамен по истории России и основам законодательства Российской Федерации для целей приобретения гражданства Российской Федерации
administering_agency: State institutions designated under Government Decree No. 1136

format.notes: A written test of up to 90 minutes, which may use computers. A separate Russian language examination, oral and written, also lasts up to 90 minutes.

unverified.administering_agency: The decree says state institutions hold the examinations; the list was not read.

recent_change.summary: Government Decree No. 1136 approved a new regulation on two separate examinations for citizenship: Russian language, and history of Russia with basics of legislation.
